meta.title: Germanic-labelled and German-speaking migrations · 100 BCE–2026 CE
meta.description: All six supplied modules, with ancient Germanic-labelled coalitions distinct from medieval/modern German speakers and North Germanic expansions. Low/central/high are visualization scenarios, not confidence intervals. Unknown source populations remain null. Source flows, resident stocks, mortality, genetic ancestry and modern descendants are different counting units. Source-free allocations are explicitly illustrative, never measured censuses.
